symptom: An immediate-only landing authorization could not use the mandatory merge wrapper, whose only mode armed auto-merge; removing the high-level CLI auto flag can still admit a merge queue.
rule: Use an explicit immediate mode with fresh fail-closed snapshots, a synchronous expected-head-guarded merge and matching merged-SHA confirmation. Bind effective GraphQL principals and the actual merger to the same REST-qualified human by login and immutable IDs; use the CLI's real optional skipping/NEUTRAL pair. Pin the effective workspace Git author email, explicitly supply authorEmail and verify both actual commit-author receipts without treating email as authentication. Refuse queue, auto-armed and bypass-capable states without cancelling existing work; preserve the legacy default and all shared policy protections. Unsupported-option reds establish feature absence, not historical safety-guard failures.
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts scripts/__tests__/agent-merge.test.ts scripts/__tests__/agent-merge-immediate.test.ts
